title: Recover a partial cold-chain controller return while preserving shared accounting effects
user_instruction: Three of the twelve CLINIC-SENSOR-A probes failed the recorded incoming inspection after receipt. Return only those three units, complete the already approved replacement order for three CLINIC-SENSOR-B probes, apply the supplier debit credit to the replacement invoice, and ensure the supplier pickup event is delivered exactly once. Preserve all nine good probes, both CLINIC-GATEWAY-X gateways, the unaffected gateway invoice, and the submitted shared Payment Entry.

ambiguous_operation.operation: submit the draft partial Purchase Return
ambiguous_operation.surface_result: HTTP connection lost before a success response
